_comment: The diagram. x, y, w, h are drawing coordinates in a 760 x 490 box. `parent` nests a node in a container. Edge sides: l, r, t, b. `files` are checked against the tree.

nodes.label: Design Studio
nodes.sub: swatchroom/, mounted in the same process
nodes.summary: The Design Studio (Swatchroom 5), kept in swatchroom/ exactly as built. Its own Express routes (/api/session, /api/rooms, /api/vision, /api/pipeline, /api/ai, /api/admin) and its browser files (/js, /css, /fonts, /textures) are mounted after the website's routes. It keeps the record of which GPU services are awake that the landing page's wake-up fills in.
responsibilities: Calls Gemini on Vertex AI with the server's Google key
Scans on the local models and OneFormer on Modal

nodes.label: Browser
nodes.summary: Opens the pages from Express and the photos and videos from /media.

nodes.label: Express website
nodes.summary: One Node process. It serves the pages and media from an allow-list, answers a small JSON API, runs the request guards, shows Coming soon for an address that is no page, and mounts the Design Studio. Express is the only runtime dependency of the website itself; the studio's packages are installed with it.
responsibilities: Serves pages and media from an allow-list; nothing else on disk
Mounts the Design Studio and starts its database connection

nodes.label: Guards
nodes.summary: Every request passes these first, in order: the Host check (421), JSON-only bodies on writes under /api/ (415; the studio's own API, which carries photos and renders as raw bytes, is exempt), and a same-origin check (403). Then nosniff and no-referrer headers are added to every response.
responsibilities: Host header must be this machine or in ALLOWED_HOSTS
Content-Type: application/json before any body is parsed

nodes.label: Health and site
nodes.summary: What the browser may know: whether the server is up, which version it is and whether the Design Studio is running, and the public site map. Never a secret.

nodes.label: Media
nodes.summary: Photos and videos from media/, only the allowed extensions, with Range support so video seeks, cached for an hour.

nodes.label: Pages
nodes.summary: Each page route in site/site.json sends its built file with Cache-Control: no-cache. Aliases (and another capital or a trailing slash) redirect with 301, design-time names with 302. A page can carry its own response headers. An address that is no page gets the Coming soon page with a 404. Nothing else on disk is ever served.

nodes.label: Site and pages
nodes.summary: site/site.json is the single definition of the site: routes, files, aliases, headers and which page must link to which. pages/ holds the four built pages Express sends.

nodes.label: Site build
nodes.summary: Turns the pristine exports into the pages: it decodes each Claude Design bundle, applies the JSON patches (anchored, each must match exactly once) and writes pages/. A changed export fails loudly instead of being half-patched.
responsibilities: Rewrite links to routes or files

nodes.label: Exports
nodes.summary: The pristine exports from Claude Design. Replace one when you export again, then run npm run build:site.
responsibilities: Input to the build; never served

nodes.label: media/
nodes.summary: The photos and videos the pages use.

nodes.label: Studio wake-up
nodes.summary: Called by the landing page and the studio page the moment they open. Starts the studio's scan service and room-analysis service(s) through the studio's own wake-up code (skipping any that are warm or already starting) and answers at once with how many it started. Not behind the studio's passcode. STUDIO_WARMUP=off turns it off.
responsibilities: Answers {warming: n}, never a name or an address

nodes.label: MongoDB
nodes.summary: Where the studio keeps rooms, versions, photos and renders (GridFS). The studio opens without it, but rooms cannot be saved.

nodes.label: Gemini (Vertex AI)
nodes.summary: Renders a finish into the photo and outlines the surfaces. Only the server calls it, with the studio's Google key; the browser never sees the key.

nodes.label: GPU services (Modal)
nodes.summary: OneFormer (the HD scan) and the room-analysis services. They scale to zero and take 10-45 s to wake; the landing page and the studio page start them early, and a started one is billed until it has been idle for about five minutes.

nodes.label: Scan models
nodes.summary: The studio's local scan (SegFormer-B5) and Pick tool (SlimSAM). Not started by npm start: run npm run models in a second terminal. Without it the studio scans with Gemini outlines only.
